THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

The allotments of below mentioned lands (Lots 12), depicted inCadastral Map No. 520028, Block No. 24, Sheet No. 4 and dated02.01.2017, prepared by Surveyor - General, situated in the Villageof Wataraka in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 448, WatarakaSouth in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Homagama inColombo District in Western Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot No. 277 – Kandebodawatta – Extent: 0.0004 HectareNorth: Lot No. 276; East: Lot No. 276 and Block 29; South andWest: Block 29.
02. Lot No. 302 – Kandebodawatta – Extent: 0.0002 HectareNorth: Lot No. 303; East: Lot Nos. 303 and 202; South: LotNo. 202; West: Lot No. 303.
